name: Finnhub General News API

name: Ars Technica

name: BleepingComputer

name: Breaking Defense

name: CISA Cybersecurity Advisories

name: Data Center Dynamics

name: U.S. Department of War - News Releases

name: EE Times

name: EIA Today in Energy

name: IAEA Top News

name: IEEE Spectrum
why: Engineering-grade reporting on emerging hardware and energy tech that flags which lab-stage capabilities are approaching commercial viability, months before markets price them.

name: IEEE Spectrum - Energy

name: Krebs on Security

name: Mining.com

name: NASA News Releases

name: NASASpaceflight.com

name: The Northern Miner

name: Nuclear Engineering International

name: Robohub
